name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take in the Garden City area?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take in the Garden City area?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen remodel timeline can vary significantly based on the scope of work, material selections, and permit requirements. A cosmetic update might take a few weeks, while a full gut and redesign, including structural changes or reconfiguring utilities, could extend to 8-12 weeks or more. Factors like custom cabinetry lead times or unexpected findings during demolition can also influence the project duration. We work to provide a clear project schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodel timelines vary, typically from a few weeks for cosmetic updates to 8-12 weeks for a full redesign, depending on scope and materials.
